title: Test Fee Aggregation Query
sql_script:
SELECT [DOWNLOADTYPE], SUM([SRNO]) AS [TotalSRNO]
FROM [MEFCampus].dbo._GENERALFORMAT t1
WHERE [DOWNLOADTYPE] IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY [DOWNLOADTYPE]
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
